root_idea.summary: The root centers on covering: placing a cover over something, or using a cover, screen, or shelter to keep it concealed or protected.
root_idea.development: From physical covering and concealment, the vocabulary extends to self-concealment, protection, shelter, modesty, and figurative concealment. The related term إِسْتَارٌ is also reported with a separate numerical sense, though its derivational relation to the root is disputed.

senses.definition: To conceal oneself; to become hidden or covered.
senses.usage_conditions: A reflexive or self-directed use in which the subject remains concealed or covers itself. The Quranic occurrence is the imperfect form تَسْتَتِرُونَ.

senses.definition: A covering, shelter, or protective screen; anything by which a person or thing is concealed or protected.
senses.usage_conditions: The Quranic use denotes a means of concealment or shelter rather than the act of covering itself.
In the Quranic phrase حِجَابًا مَسْتُورًا, the veil is interpreted either as hidden from people or as covered by another veil, implying a thick or doubly veiled screen.
An exceptional active-value interpretation of مَسْتُورٌ in the same Quranic construction: the veil itself prevents, hinders, or obstructs access.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To veil, conceal, hide, or cover something; to protect or safeguard another.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Transitive Form I; protection is an extended use of shielding another from harm or exposure.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To be or become modest or bashful.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A stative or inchoative use describing modest conduct.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To be or become intelligent.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative use recorded as a separate lexical extension.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To conceal enmity with someone.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Form III construction involving concealed hostility.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To protect oneself from divine displeasure by piety; hence, to fear God.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Occurs in the idiomatic construction اِسْتَتَرَ مِنَ اللهِ بِسِتْرٍ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To expose or disgrace someone by revealing his faults.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative idiomatic use in هَتَكَ سِتْرَهُ, literally to rend his covering.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Fear of divine displeasure; modesty or bashfulness.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Figurative meanings associated with the protective function of a cover.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Intelligence or sound judgment.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative nominal use, synonymous with عقلٌ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A shield.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A concrete protective object.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A barrier placed before a person who is praying.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A physical object set up in front of the worshipper as a screening boundary.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A parapet or surrounding wall of a flat rooftop.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A structural barrier enclosing or screening a roof.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A shade or canopy.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A covering structure understood as a ظُلَّةٌ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Veiled, concealed, or covered.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An adjective for a person or thing kept from view; the lexical evidence records both masculine and feminine applications.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Modest, bashful, or chaste.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative adjectival extension from being kept covered or concealed.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Dense with boughs or branches.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied figuratively to trees having many branches.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Veiling or protecting; a veiler or protector.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: When applied to God, the form is explained as فَعِيلٌ in the sense of فَاعِلٌ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The piece of skin over the nail.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An anatomical covering.

other_classical_meanings.definition: One who veils or conceals much, often, or well; a keeper of a curtain.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An intensive agent noun, also used for the person responsible for a curtain closing a chamber door.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Four; a fourth of a party or group.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A numerical use recorded separately from the covering vocabulary; its relation to the root is disputed.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A weight of four and a half mithqals.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A separate weight term, also reported as an Arabicized borrowing.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Kept behind or within a curtain.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A descriptive passive form for someone kept out of view.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A wheedler or cajoler who conceals enmity.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative active-participial use describing concealed hostility beneath conciliatory behavior.

cautions: The Form VIII public headword is normalized to the perfect اِسْتَتَرَ; the supplied Quran occurrence is an inflected imperfect form.
مَسْتُورٌ in حِجَابًا مَسْتُورًا has more than one classical interpretation, including a passive sense of being hidden or covered and an active-value sense of preventing or obstructing.
